about: Which of Concierge's sentences Tejas reads in thnkr.ing: everything passed to a carrier call, written inside a carrier function, or in a file whose words are all for him. Checked at every commit by thinkering's scripts/check-user-words.mjs (rules: scripts/his-words-rules.json there). A new path that puts words in front of him is added here in the same commit.
